title: Async Database & HTTP Clients in Python

scenes.line1: Why use async clients for I/O?
scenes.say: Ever wondered why async database and HTTP clients are a must for scalable Python apps?

scenes.label: Async
scenes.sub: Async clients use coroutines for non-blocking network calls.
scenes.say: Async clients rely on coroutines to avoid blocking the event loop during network operations.

scenes.code:
import httpx
async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
    resp = await client.get('https://example.com')
scenes.say: Here's how you make a non-blocking HTTP request with an async client. The event loop stays free to handle other tasks.
Async clients let you serve lots of users at once, while blocking clients slow everything down.

scenes.question: Can you call blocking functions in async coroutines?
scenes.right: No, it stalls the event loop and kills concurrency.
scenes.say: Watch out! Calling blocking functions inside async coroutines ruins your concurrency and scalability.
